Crypto is one of the few markets where retail can still get genuinely early on things.

But most people spend that advantage on memes and leverage instead.

Every cycle, there's always some new exciting projects that are here to stay. These days a lot of them are also strong revenue generating projects.

Watch out for those kind of projects combined with solid tokenomics. You can have a ton of buybacks but if it is constantly offset by big investor unlocks you're not really getting anywhere either.

You need solid tokenomics and metrics even during market downturns. Those are the projects that have survived and will continue to survive throughout the cycles.

tweets.text:
I don't think you've been following me closely enough.

First, the DXY. I believe the dollar is setting up for another major move higher. A stronger dollar tightens financial conditions and tends to put pressure on risk assets, especially crypto and altcoins.

Second, the technicals. We're seeing former monthly support levels turn into resistance. When price breaks down, retests those levels from below, and fails to reclaim them, that's a bearish signal.

Third, the technological risk. AI is advancing at an incredible pace, with companies like OpenAI pushing the boundaries of what's possible, while quantum computing continues to develop. Both could pose serious long-term challenges to the cryptographic security that much of the crypto market relies on. I don't think the market is adequately pricing in these risks, and I believe the gap between technological progress and market awareness could become a major headwind for crypto.

My thesis isn't simply "the market has topped."

It's that a strengthening dollar, bearish technicals, and the growing threat AI and quantum computing pose to crypto's underlying security could create the perfect storm for risk assets.

Could I be wrong? Absolutely. If the DXY thesis fails or the market reclaims key resistance levels, I'll reassess.

But right now, I believe the risk is heavily skewed to the downside, particularly for altcoins.
